artworks.title: Golden Gate
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a stone wall with a gate, debris on the ground, a couple of figures, and a sky in varying shades of gray and brown.

artworks.title: Jerusalem - Section of Old City
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a historic stone fortification with massive towers and walls built from rectangular stones. The view is from an elevated perspective looking down, showing the structure with a high horizon. A flag waves on the tallest tower on the right. The architecture consists of intact and partial walls, with at least one arched entrance visible. The color palette is monochromatic, varying shades of gray. The image may appear more like a historical photograph with fine details, rather than a painting. Other buildings extend into the distance beyond the stone structures.

artworks.title: Porte de Damas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of a large stone gate complex with high walls. The horizon is at the top of the image. The walls appear sturdy with heavy texture and substantial stonework. The color palette is primarily sepia brown. The ground in front of the gate is rocky with patches of dirt and a path leading to the entrance where several figures are visible. In the distance, to the right of the gate, domed structures can be seen.

artworks.title: The Harbour at Malta
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a vintage harbor scene with several three-masted ships and buildings near the water. The ships are adorned with intricate rigging, and the buildings appear to be made of stone and brick. In the background, a cityscape with tightly packed buildings extends to the horizon. The horizon is near the top third of the composition, providing space to appreciate the details of the scene. The photograph is in sepia tones, common in 19th-century photography, which creates a warm, nostalgic atmosphere and highlights the structures.

artworks.title: Mosque of Eyoub
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a cobblestone street winding into the distance. On the right side is a highly decorated building with two men near it. One man is seated on the steps while the other is standing against the building. The building features intricate carvings, lattice-patterned windows, arched windows, and terminates in a domed structure with detailed stonework. To the left, there is a long wall with arched niches leading to a group of trees. The image is monochromatic with clear details of the trees, building architecture, and cobblestones.

artworks.title: Panorama of Constantinople
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows an aerial view of a historical cityscape. Traditional buildings with flat roofs fill the foreground, while large mosques with domes and minarets stand out in the middle ground. The scene includes a variety of smaller structures and a body of water in the distance, with hills on the horizon. The color palette is subtle and muted, giving the scene a timeless quality.

artworks.title: Hagia Sophia from Place l'Hippodrome
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape looking towards a busy street. People guide carts pulled by oxen on a dirt path in the foreground. In the center, a mosque with a large dome and four minarets stands out. The skyline is above the buildings, with wooden structures lining the street. The scene is in sepia tones, emphasizing shades of brown.

artworks.title: Şehzade Mosque
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a large historic building with a domed roof and a tall decorative minaret in a courtyard with a tree in the foreground. The building exhibits classical architectural elements such as arches, columns, and intricate stonework. There is an impressive minaret adorned with ornamental patterns, and a series of arched windows running along the facade of the building. The tree in the foreground provides a natural contrast to the architecture. The overall composition captures the scale of the building and its craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Vue dans le Grand Cimetière de Scutari (Scene in the Large Cemetery of Scutari)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a path bordered by tall cypress trees on both sides, forming a natural archway. A slender minaret is visible in the distance at the center of the scene. The horizon is low in the frame, highlighting the vertical elements of the trees and the minaret. The composition features a range of tones from dark shadows to light highlights. The path is broad and well-lit, with some individuals walking along it. The color scheme is grayscale, typical of early black-and-white photography.

artworks.title: Gate to Imperial Palace and Fountain of Ahmed III
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an ornate architectural structure in a courtyard. The image captures a detailed section of an intricately decorated pavilion or kiosk with carvings and latticework. In the background, there is a large building with arched doorways and windows. The ground is covered with rough stone slabs, and objects like baskets and crates are placed around. The architectural elements feature decorative stone or tile patterns. The photograph has a sepia tone, giving it a vintage appearance.

artworks.title: Arsenal and Mosque of Kiledeh Ali Pasha
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a cityscape with a prominent mosque in the distance, featuring two minarets and a central dome. The background shows a hillside with many buildings. In the foreground, there are cannons lined up along a stone quay, with people in period clothing near the water. The image is in sepia tones, giving it an antique look, with clear details captured in a photograph.

artworks.title: Aussicht aus meinem Fenster, via valfonda in Florenz (Gardens in Florence Seen from the Artist's Window)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, overlooking a garden and a distant landscape. The drawing depicts hills, closely packed buildings, a structure with open arches and a foliage-covered roof, two tall cypress trees, a garden with trees and pathways, and a monochromatic color scheme created using varying shades of grey pencil.

artworks.title: Venus with the Graces and Putti
artworks.dimensions: sheet: 19.6 x 16.8 cm (7 11/16 x 6 5/8 in.) (cut to platemark)
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of classical mythological figures surrounded by cherubs. The image features several women, with one standing in the center, holding flowers in one hand while extending a cloth or drapery with the other. Seated among them are other women, draped in flowing garments with stylized hair. These figures are surrounded by cherubs with wings. The drawing is rendered in a monochrome palette, using shading and cross-hatching to convey depth and texture. The scene exudes tranquility and harmonious beauty, emphasizing the elegance and grace of the figures.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image features the bust of a person with a three-quarter view of their face. The person's facial features, including a strong jawline and well-defined cheekbones, are detailed. The individual is wearing a hat with a ribbon, and has medium-length curly hair. They are also shown wearing a collared garment that may be a jacket or cloak. The background has a textured pattern and the image is rendered in a monochromatic tone.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony of Padua
artworks.creditLine: The Washington Print Club Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a robed figure surrounded by cherubs in a celestial setting. The scene includes an individual in a robe pointing upward toward a group of cherubic figures. Clouds and angelic forms fill the background, creating an ethereal atmosphere. The lower part of the image shows details like books or manuscripts lying on the ground. The overall depiction suggests a meeting or vision, characterized by a strong sense of spiritual or heavenly interaction.

artworks.title: Nymphs Bathing in a Cave
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Marion Deshmukh
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with architectural ruins and figures amid livestock. The image features several figures, most of whom are in classical attire or nude, seated or standing among an abundance of livestock, including cows and goats. The setting is rural, indicated by an abundance of trees and rocks. Two large trees on the left side cast shadows across part of the scene, while figures on the right appear engaged in relaxed dialogue or observation. In the background, more animals can be seen parading through a lush landscape, framed by more trees under an expansive sky.

artworks.title: Out for a Walk
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image features two women in traditional attire from head to toe. The woman on the left holds a parasol above them, has styled hair with a hairpin, and wears a checkered kimono with a floral obi and geta sandals. The woman on the right has styled hair with a hairpin, wears a simpler kimono in a darker shade with a lighter obi, and stands on a patterned floor with a plain neutral backdrop.

artworks.title: At Her Toilet
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing upright, holding a fan in each hand. She is wearing a traditional Japanese kimono with a checkered pattern and a colorful belt. The woman's hair is styled in an updo. She has a calm and focused expression. There is a bowl on the floor and a small section of a mat underneath her feet. In the background, there is a decorated box with a teapot-like object.

artworks.title: Sleeping Beauties
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts two women lying down on a patterned surface covered by a thick comforter. They are both mostly obscured, with one woman visible from the lower chest upwards and the other woman's face peeking over the shoulder of the first. They both lie on their sides, heads resting on their hands. The woman in front has dark hair styled back and closed eyes, and she is wearing a kimono with a purple pattern and a bow accent. In front of her is a small blue and white cup and a long object resembling a pipe. Beside them is a wooden and paper lantern. The backdrop is a simple, muted wall.

artworks.title: Moos'mie
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman wearing a striped kimono and dark obi. She has short, dark hair and is holding a traditional umbrella. She is standing upright in front of a simple, neutral-toned background with a patterned floor.

artworks.title: Musical Party
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows four women seated on the floor with musical instruments partially visible. Two women on the left are playing instruments. The second from the left holds a string instrument resembling a biwa, and the woman furthest left appears to hold a shamisen. The women have traditional Japanese hairstyles with hairpins. Their faces are adorned with subtle makeup. They are dressed in traditional Japanese kimonos with serene colors. A small table in front of them holds what appears to be tea kettles and cups. The background features a painted screen with depictions of nature, showing foliage and possibly birds.

artworks.title: Young Lady and Servant
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: In the image, there are two people in traditional Japanese attire. One person is standing facing forward, while the other stands slightly behind and to the side holding an umbrella. The person on the right has dark hair styled back with decorative pins, wearing a blue striped kimono with a floral design. The person on the left also has dark hair styled neatly, wearing a pink and gray kimono. Both are in traditional Japanese footwear. The person on the left holds a large umbrella over the other. The background is plain with a textured floor.

artworks.title: Putting on the Obi or Girdle
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image depicts two women standing side by side. The woman on the left is slightly turned, holding a folded piece of fabric. She has her hair styled up and wears traditional Japanese clothing with a dark kimono and yellow obi. The woman on the right is adjusting a fabric around her waist, focused on her task. She also wears traditional attire with dark tones and purple accents. Various fabric pieces, sewing tools, and a sewing box are scattered around them. The background is a textured brown backdrop.

artworks.title: Priest or Zen Shu
artworks.medium: albumen silver print with applied color
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Michael and Jane Wilson
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals standing side by side facing left. Both individuals have shaved heads and are dressed in traditional robes, holding beads with pink tassels. The background is simple with a shadowed oval vignette framing the figures. The flooring has a geometric checkered pattern.
